findings.finding: The musl choice itself is supported: the W03 plan records Q3 'musl, fully static', and W01-AMEND-QW4 says the same. But the claim that no GCC runtime is linked may not hold. In rustc_target's crt_objects, Rust's self-contained *-linux-musl linking adds crtbegin.o/crtbeginS.o and crtend.o/crtendS.o next to musl's crt1/crti/crtn. Those objects come from the GCC toolchain and are under GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1. I could not confirm this offline: no local musl target, and no network read was made. If it holds, HE-001's gate enumeration of the self-contained objects would classify those objects as OUT_OF_SCOPE, because the class names only libgcc and libgcc_eh in containerd, pause and runc. That fails closed, but HE-001 would then need a further owner decision. The classifier's behaviour is correct either way; only the README sentence is affected.
findings.requiredChange: None for this packet. Before HE-001, check the crt objects of the pinned Rust commit's musl target. Then either reword the sentence (for example, 'no glibc; GCC crt objects, if present, are OUT_OF_SCOPE pending an owner decision') or confirm it.

L18.reason: Each class component is now bound to one decided term, its kinds and, for a static library, its decided binaries. CLASS_COMPONENTS, the record and check() pin all three. I re-ran the round-3 L18 probes. glibc static with GPL-2.0-or-later, LGPL-2.1-only or the GCC runtime term: OUT_OF_SCOPE. glibc host with 'GPL-2.0-or-later OR LGPL-2.1-only': OUT_OF_SCOPE. libnftnl with LGPL-2.1-or-later: OUT_OF_SCOPE. libseccomp in containerd or pause: OUT_OF_SCOPE. 'LGPL-2.1-or-later AND GPL-2.0-or-later' for glibc static: OUT_OF_SCOPE. 'LGPL-2.1-or-later OR GPL-2.0-or-later' for glibc elects the decided LGPL-2.1-or-later. The libpathrs election is bound to runc; in containerd the ranking still elects MPL-2.0. A full matrix of 768 probes covered 8 names, 3 kinds, 5 link targets, both custodies, both link custodies and the 4 class terms. Exactly the 13 decided tuples come out HOST_OS_SYSTEM_LIBRARY: glibc LGPL-2.1-or-later as host library, or static in containerd, pause and runc; libseccomp LGPL-2.1-only static in runc; libgcc and libgcc_eh GCC runtime static in containerd, pause and runc; libnftnl GPL-2.0-or-later and libmnl LGPL-2.1-or-later as host libraries. All 13 mutations of class components and election binaries were refused.
